name: Ashihara Daiki
source:
Daiki has a habit of telling people his true thoughts which often leads the girls around him to embarrassment when he tells them he's thinking of them.

He tells the Yagami sisters that he transferred schools to find a wife despite his sister [url=https://vndb.org/c34480]Kirino's[/url] warnings against doing so leading them to excitement and embarrassment at being his bridal candidates.
